suite.selection_basis: Selected from contract.json and the supplied clean Lean sources before either arm, without trial artifacts, historical research, external literature, or proof attempts. Independently computed SHA256 of MathGKM/Markov.lean matches the contract. Freeze both tasks and retain unfavorable outcomes. All Lean strings use standard notation in an environment importing MathGKM.Markov; they have not been compiler-validated. Statements and transport types are obligations, not supplied answers. Interface types specify reusable contracts without prescribing implementations or proof methods. Require source-bound, kernel-checked interface inhabitants and transport proofs under the contract's axiom restrictions. Scope is reviewed judgment, not proof that these tasks characterize root difficulty. required_constants lists existing source anchors, not hypothetical future component names: prescribing unavailable future names could make the benchmark useless. These anchors alone do not establish component reuse; that requires inspection of actual interface consumption in transport proofs. Model praise is not transfer evidence. Neither task audits correspondence with the published source family.

tasks.interface_type: ∀ (R : ℕ → ℕ → Prop), R 0 1 → R 1 1 → (∀ (path : List Bool), R (MathGKM.Markov.frame path).mid.a (MathGKM.Markov.frame path).mid.b) → ∀ (a b : ℕ), 0 < b → a ≤ b → Nat.Coprime a b → R a b
tasks.scope: Unbounded coverage of every reduced natural numerator/positive denominator pair in [0,1], with 0/1 and 1/1 explicitly separated from middle labels. The reusable interface transfers arbitrary predicates from those endpoints and every path middle label to every such rational pair. The source transport additionally requires an actual polynomial witness from the pinned endpoint/path family and its exact raw WeakLC property, conditional on Conjecture63. No claim of label uniqueness, converse validity of every generated label, equality of polynomials for repeated labels, or agreement with the published rational-indexed family is included. Coverage is a structural correspondence obligation and does not establish log-concavity.
tasks.statement: ∀ (a b : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ≤ b) (hcop : Nat.Coprime a b), (a = 0 ∧ b = 1) ∨ (a = 1 ∧ b = 1) ∨ ∃ (path : List Bool), (MathGKM.Markov.frame path).mid.a = a ∧ (MathGKM.Markov.frame path).mid.b = b
tasks.transport_type: MathGKM.Markov.Conjecture63 → ∀ (a b : ℕ), 0 < b → a ≤ b → Nat.Coprime a b → ∃ (P : MathGKM.Markov.BiPoly), ((a = 0 ∧ b = 1 ∧ P = 1) ∨ (a = 1 ∧ b = 1 ∧ P = MathGKM.Markov.U + MathGKM.Markov.V) ∨ (∃ (path : List Bool), (MathGKM.Markov.frame path).mid.a = a ∧ (MathGKM.Markov.frame path).mid.b = b ∧ (MathGKM.Markov.frame path).mid.p = P)) ∧ MathGKM.Markov.WeakLC a b P

tasks.interface_type: {T : MathGKM.Markov.BiPoly → MathGKM.Markov.BiPoly // (∀ (P : MathGKM.Markov.BiPoly) (i j : ℕ), MathGKM.Markov.coeff (T P) i j = MathGKM.Markov.coeff P j i) ∧ (∀ (P : MathGKM.Markov.BiPoly) (a b : ℕ), MathGKM.Markov.WeakLC a b P ↔ MathGKM.Markov.WeakLC b a (T P))}
tasks.scope: Uniform exchange of the outer and inner polynomial variables for arbitrary integer bivariate polynomials, with exact coefficient equality at every natural index and exact WeakLC equivalence for every natural label pair. No positivity, nonzero-coefficient, support, degree, reachability, or log-concavity hypothesis is permitted. The interface must supply an operation satisfying both laws, not merely assume one exists. Transport must cover the entire pinned root, including both endpoints, with labels exchanged alongside coefficients and all three directions and zeros retained. This is a representation regression target selected as a fresh holdout; it neither asserts that exchanged polynomials belong to the original recurrence family nor characterizes the difficulty of proving the root.
tasks.statement: ∀ (P : MathGKM.Markov.BiPoly), ∃ (Q : MathGKM.Markov.BiPoly), (∀ (i j : ℕ), MathGKM.Markov.coeff Q i j = MathGKM.Markov.coeff P j i) ∧ (∀ (a b : ℕ), MathGKM.Markov.WeakLC a b P ↔ MathGKM.Markov.WeakLC b a Q)
tasks.transport_type: ∀ (T : MathGKM.Markov.BiPoly → MathGKM.Markov.BiPoly), (∀ (P : MathGKM.Markov.BiPoly) (i j : ℕ), MathGKM.Markov.coeff (T P) i j = MathGKM.Markov.coeff P j i) → (MathGKM.Markov.Conjecture63 ↔ (MathGKM.Markov.WeakLC 1 0 (T 1) ∧ MathGKM.Markov.WeakLC 1 1 (T (MathGKM.Markov.U + MathGKM.Markov.V)) ∧ ∀ (path : List Bool), let m := (MathGKM.Markov.frame path).mid; MathGKM.Markov.WeakLC m.b m.a (T m.p)))
